title: openams_spoolman materials list, version 1 (C4 §9.3)
description: The answer of GET /server/openams_spoolman/materials (JSON-RPC server.openams_spoolman.materials), C4 §9.3: the materials Spoolman holds, each once, sorted without case, with the extruder temperature the host's table (C4 §7.4, material_temps merged over the built-in one) gives each, or null.

name.description: The material as Spoolman spells it (the first spelling, when several differ only in case).

extruder_temp.description: °C: what C4 §7.4's table gives a spool of this material, or null when it gives none (a UI then asks for one).
